objective: It is considered necessary to amend the Karnataka Irrigation Act, 1965 (Karnataka Act 16 of 1965) to prevent illegal tapping of water and Ensure water reaches the end user accordingly,- (i) define new expressions of “agricultural equipments”, “canal”, “command area”, “irrigation court”, “task force” and “unauthorized use of water from canal”; (ii) substitute “the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Central Act 30 of 2013)” instead of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (Central Act 01 of 1994 )”. (iii) grant permit to extract and use of ground water, registration of existing groundwater users and penalty for contravention of sections 28A and 28B; (iv) enhance the period of punishment, extend the duration of punishment and increase the amount of penalty on conviction of an offence; (v) insert the Irrigation Court, Savings of inherent powers of the irrigation court, place of inquiry, procedure of evidence, summoning and inquiry etc.,; (vi) application of Limitation Act and fix the duration of 6 months for speedy disposal of proceedings; - and certain other consequential amendments. Hence the Bill. 11
